title: Optery at eCourts 2026
summary: Visit Optery at eCourts, Booth 223, Dec 7-9 at the MGM Grand Casino and Hotel in Las Vegas. See how we find and remove exposed employee data to help prevent cyber and physical threats.
body_markdown:
Join Optery at eCourts in Las Vegas, Nevada to see how we remove exposed employee and executive personal data from the open web to help organizations reduce cyber and physical risk.


Stop by our booth to learn how Optery’s award-winning solution helps prevent:


- Social engineering and impersonation attacks (phishing, smishing, vishing)
- Credential compromise, account takeover, and BEC
- Real-world targeting and physical threats


Optery does the work end-to-end, continuously finding and removing more exposed profiles per person than any other service by far.


## Event Details


🏢 **Location:** MGM Grand Casino & Hotel
🗓️ **Date:** December 7-9, 2026
**📍Optery Booth:** 223


[Register](https://ecourts.ncsc.org/)


## About eCourts


eCourts is NCSC’s most immersive education conference with plenary-style learning where attendees are fully exposed to the entire educational agenda. Presenters are industry leaders, peer court colleagues, and recognized subject-matter experts who are focused on developing meaningful ways to use technology to strengthen court administration.


NCSC partners with courts across technology implementation, strategy, policy development, and assessment. Their expertise in court technology and reputation for trusted advice and proven solutions help attract some of the best talent in the country to eCourts. Relationships with the Conference of Chief Justices, Conference of State Court Administrators, and the Court Information Technology Officers’ Consortium strengthen conference programming by featuring a wealth of practical resources, tools, and guidance.


## About Optery


Optery helps individuals and organizations reduce the risks of cyber and physical attacks by identifying and removing personal information from hundreds of data brokers and people-search sites.[Optery for Business](https://www.optery.com/business/) minimizes employee and executive exposure to phishing, smishing, vishing, BEC, impersonation, and physical targeting. Optery was ranked the #1 most effective of all personal data removal services tested in a 2024 study by Consumer Reports, and is the most-awarded personal data-removal service in the industry: PCMag Editors’ Choice (2022–2026), Cyber Defense Magazine Top InfoSec Innovator (2024–2025), SiliconANGLE TechForward Award (2025), Fortress Cybersecurity Award (2026), Cybersecurity Excellence Awards (2024–2026), and Fast Company’s Next Big Things in Tech (2023).
